original.statement: The Marathon provider has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 and Marathon-related configuration is no longer supported.

decision.reason: [ev-c71146d39072] says that in v3 the Marathon provider has been removed. Its v2 static-configuration example uses the key providers.marathon (`providers: marathon: {}` / `[providers.marathon]`), and the text says this configuration is now unsupported. A config-key subject at path providers.marathon with change type "removed" therefore matches the evidence.
